*Integrated DNA, RNA and Whole-Blood Analysis Provides Deeper Molecular Insights for Precision Oncology*


**IRVING, Texas – September 29, 2026** –[Caris Life Sciences](https://www.carislifesciences.com/) ®, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAI), a leading TechBio company, today unveiled the enhanced Caris Assure®, a new evolution of liquid biopsy. By integrating Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), Whole Transcriptome Sequencing (WTS) and whole-blood analysis (for true CHIP identification) into a single platform, the enhanced Caris Assure assay provides a more complete molecular profile from a single blood draw, delivering deeper insights to help guide precision oncology decisions.


Designed to address longstanding limitations of traditional liquid biopsy approaches, enhanced Caris Assure incorporates multiple improvements to its comprehensive DNA and RNA analysis combined with whole-blood testing to help distinguish tumor-derived alterations from clonal hematopoiesis and incidental germline findings. The enhanced version of Caris Assure includes validation that tumor fraction correlates with risk of progression and treatment efficacy in patients who receive repeated testing, and results are categorized into molecular response, intermediate, or molecular progression for patients with multiple tests while on treatment. This additional capability creates the opportunity to use Caris Assure to understand how patients are benefiting from their treatment plan. The result is a richer, more clinically actionable molecular profile that enables physicians to make more informed treatment decisions throughout the cancer care continuum.


“The enhancements to Caris Assure that we’re announcing today represent a significant advancement in our mission to deliver the most comprehensive molecular information possible from a blood sample,” said[David B. Spetzler](https://www.carislifesciences.com/bio/david-spetzler-ms-phd-mba/) , MS, PhD, MBA, President of Caris Life Sciences. “By combining enhanced Whole Exome Sequencing, Whole Transcriptome Sequencing and whole-blood analysis into a single integrated platform, we are providing physicians with deeper biological insights that can help inform therapy selection and patient management.”


The enhanced platform delivers broad genomic coverage across more than 23,000 genes, with therapy-focused sequencing depth reaching up to 40,000x and increasing RNA reads to ~600M. WTS provides complementary RNA-based insights, including improved fusion detection capabilities and expanded biomarker discovery. Enhanced Caris Assure also incorporates validated Human Leukocyte Antigen (HLA) reporting, expanded pharmacogenomic reporting and an enhanced clinical report designed to provide a more comprehensive view of clinically relevant molecular findings.


Complementing these scientific advancements, enhanced Caris Assure introduces a refined reporting experience with improved visualization of molecular findings and a median turnaround time of approximately seven days. Together, these enhancements are designed to help physicians access actionable insights faster and make more confident treatment decisions for their patients.


Enhanced Caris Assure builds upon Caris’ longstanding leadership in comprehensive molecular profiling and reflects the company’s continued commitment to advancing precision oncology through molecular science, large-scale data generation and artificial intelligence. By integrating DNA, RNA and whole-blood analysis into a single assay, Caris is establishing a new benchmark for molecular information that can be obtained from a blood sample.


**About Caris Assure**


Caris Assure® is a comprehensive liquid biopsy platform designed to provide molecular insights from a blood sample. The enhanced assay combines Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), Whole Transcriptome Sequencing (WTS) and whole-blood analysis to deliver a more complete molecular profile that supports precision oncology decision-making.


**About Caris Life Sciences**


Caris Life Sciences® (Caris) is a leading TechBio company actively developing and commercializing innovative solutions to transform healthcare. Through comprehensive molecular profiling (Whole Genome, Whole Exome and Whole Transcriptome Sequencing), advanced AI and machine learning, Caris has created the large-scale, multimodal clinico-genomic database and computing capability needed to analyze and further unravel the molecular complexity of disease. This convergence of next-generation sequencing, AI and machine learning technologies and high-performance computing provides a differentiated platform for developing the latest generation of advanced precision medicine diagnostic solutions for early detection, diagnosis, monitoring, therapy selection and drug development.


Caris was founded with a vision to realize the potential of precision medicine to improve the human condition. Headquartered in Irving, Texas, Caris has offices in Phoenix, New York, Cambridge (MA), Tokyo, Japan and Basel, Switzerland. Caris or its distributor partners provide services in the U.S. and other international markets.
